## How to Add Your Name

If you've contributed to this project and would like to add your name to this list, please submit a pull request with your information. Include:
- Your name (or GitHub username)
- A brief description of your contribution
- Any relevant links (GitHub profile, personal website, etc.)

## Recognition

We appreciate all contributions, whether they are:
- Code contributions
- Documentation improvements
- Bug reports
- Feature suggestions
- Testing and feedback
- Community support

Thank you to everyone who has helped make this project better!
